notes.title: Update Notes for Apiril 21
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

All the updates from the Play Test have been moved to the official game, which includes the new sneaking levels, enemies, and other platforming mechanics. Thanks for all the feedback so far—that made this update possible!

notes.title: Incoming Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, there are many new updates for CPR. I added the following:

[list]
[*] New Enemies
[*] New Tutorial Levels
[*] A new exploratory mechanic so that Jaelyn can explore the world around her.
[*] New music
[*]  New boss battle attacks
[*] A real-time cutscene has been added
[*] Level titles have been added when moving from one room to another
[*] New traps have been added
[*]  The Drone enemy mechanics have been changed
[*]  Brand new art assets have been added
[/list]

The following bugs have also been fixed:
[list]
[*] Collisions that previously caused Jaelyn's animation to glitch have been fixed
[*] Laser Barrier can't be passed without an ability
[*] The map and inventory can no longer be accessed from the Game Over screen
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
With this update, although not featuring major additions, a range of refinements have been implemented and they are the following:

[list]
[*]New artwork has been added
[*]Optimized performance by minimizing frames in animations
[*]Made the drone a little less aggressive
[*]New music has been added
[*]A new enemy has been added
[/list]

The demo levels are nearly complete and the game's identity is almost fully developed. Any feedback at this stage of development would incredibly helpful.

Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far!

notes.title: Small Update 10-30-2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Cutscenes have been re-rendered
[*]Cutscenes are now skippable
[*]Dropping the claw no longer makes unobtainable
[*]Camera has been zoomed out
[*]Collisions have been refined
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
CHANGES:

Loading Saved Files:

Fixed an issue where loading saved files from the menu resulted in errors.

Level Transitions:

Addressed an issue where level transitions were not functioning correctly, ensuring smoother gameplay progression.

Inventory Controls Bug:

Resolved a bug that previously caused control problems when exiting the inventory screen.


Parallax Sky Effect:

Corrected the parallax sky effect to enhance visual quality and consistency.

Demo Levels Revision:

Improved and refined the demo levels to provide a better gameplay experience.

Game Progression:

Fixed a blocking issue that occurred after loading a saved game, allowing players to continue their journey without interruption.

notes.title: Updated Foundation
notes.notes:
Introducing the latest update to the game, where enhancements have breathed new life into the experience:

🌟 **Refined Collision System:** A meticulously tuned collision system ensures the player's grappling interactions are both immersive and strategic.

⚡ **Traps Unleashed:** Fresh challenges await with the addition of new traps that will test your wit and reflexes.

🤖 **Elevated Enemy AI:** Enemies now boast improved artificial intelligence, creating engaging encounters that demand adaptability and skill.

🎬 **Revamped Animations:** Immerse yourself in smoother and more captivating animations that enhance every movement and action.

🌎 **Expanded Horizons:** Embark on new adventures with the introduction of captivating levels, offering fresh twists and turns.

🎵 **Harmonious Melodies:** Immerse yourself in the game's world with brand-new music tracks that set the perfect tone for your journey.

🚀 **Seamless Transitions:** Experience uninterrupted gameplay as the player no longer grapples during spawn transitions.

🔊 **Enhanced SFX:** The soundscapes have been elevated with updated sound effects, adding an extra layer of immersion.

🔧 **Polished Details:** Countless refinements, both minor and meaningful, have been meticulously woven into the game's fabric.

Please note that this marks the penultimate update for the demo showcase, with the final update projected to be unveiled in September. We invite you to share your invaluable feedback in the comment section below. Your insights play an instrumental role in the game's evolution, helping us shape a better gaming experience for all.

Thank you for your support and dedication to making this journey an exceptional one!

Warm regards,
Adrian
